value.rationale: A complete, natural all-column incidence classification for a canonical four-row Fourier family on infinitely many composite cyclic orders, giving three exceptional index mechanisms, precise minor counts, and the sharp divisor-uniform equivalence within this family. The central index p+1 creates a non-antipodal equal-pair-sum obstruction, not implied by the fixed index d=4 proof. This information distinguishes erasure patterns beyond the standard full-spark yes/no question.
